set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §0 P2, §3 Phase 1a Step 5, §5 item 4.

Phase 1a runs language models locally first. Hosted arms (a frontier model, TypeSafe's Jev) run only after this decision. Local runs are already permitted (Sherlock README:63-66; FilmFestival README:36-37). Related: the licence and ethics dispositions bead (bd-01M184XP908JX51S3ZYFX20HC7) covers component licences and the FilmFestival and recall-corpus ethics bases; this bead covers only hosted-API use and spend, so those other items do not block the hosted arms or the final test.

Scope:
One decision per corpus (Sherlock, FilmFestival, Friends, Memento), a spend ceiling, and Jev early-access status.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Per corpus: allowed / not allowed to send recall prose to a hosted API, with any conditions (provider, retention, no-redistribution conditions such as FilmFestival README:46).
2. A spend ceiling in dollars for the hosted Phase 1a arms and for H1.
3. Jev early-access status recorded (applied / granted / declined / not pursued).

Gate: the owner's decision is recorded verbatim, or faithfully summarized and confirmed by the
owner, as a decision note on this bead.

Size: S (owner).
set.title: OWNER: may participant recall prose go to hosted model APIs (per corpus), and at what spend?
